tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description:
Search several scientific sources in one explicitly audited workflow.

    Args:
        query: scientific evidence query sent to each selected source
        agent_id: calling agent or workflow identity
        sources: any of pubmed, europepmc, clinicaltrials, uniprot, opentargets
        max_resu

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search all evidence sources for ChatGPT/Codex knowledge compatibility.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one preserved evidence record by retrieval ID.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a persistent scientist research project.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List scientist research projects.

tools.name: create_evidence_collection
tools.description: Create a reviewed evidence collection in a project.

tools.name: list_evidence_collections
tools.description: List evidence collections, optionally within one project.

tools.name: add_evidence_to_collection
tools.description: Add or update a retrieval in a scientist-reviewed evidence collection.

tools.name: get_evidence_collection
tools.description: Return a collection and its reviewed evidence items.

tools.name: create_evidence_watch
tools.description: Create a saved query for explicit evidence-change monitoring.

tools.name: list_evidence_watches
tools.description: List saved evidence watches, optionally within one project.

tools.name: run_evidence_watch
tools.description: Run one evidence watch and record added, removed, or revised evidence.

tools.name: list_evidence_events
tools.description: List change events previously detected by an evidence watch.

tools.name: run_all_evidence_watches
tools.description: Run all active watches and return explicit per-watch failures.

tools.name: create_claim
tools.description: Create a scientific claim record without asserting that it is true.

tools.name: link_claim_evidence
tools.description: Propose or record how one retrieval relates to a claim.

tools.name: trace_claim
tools.description: Trace a claim to supporting, conflicting, contextual, or insufficient evidence.

tools.name: get_project_report
tools.description: Return collections, claims, evidence links, watches, and events for a project.

tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description:
Search PubMed and log every retrieved paper to the audit trail.

    Args:
        query: exact search string, sent to PubMed verbatim — no normalization
        agent_id: which agent is asking, e.g. "aletheia:advocate"
        max_results: how many papers to retrieve (default 5)

tools.name: search_europepmc
tools.description:
Search Europe PMC and log every retrieved article to the audit trail.

    Args:
        query: exact search string, sent to Europe PMC verbatim — no normalization
        agent_id: which agent is asking, e.g. "aletheia:advocate"
        max_results: how many articles to retrieve (default 5)

tools.name: search_clinicaltrials
tools.description:
Search ClinicalTrials.gov and log every retrieved study to the audit trail.

    Args:
        query: condition/disease search string, sent to ClinicalTrials.gov verbatim
        agent_id: which agent is asking, e.g. "aletheia:advocate"
        max_results: how many studies to retrieve (default 5)

tools.name: search_biorxiv
tools.description:
List bioRxiv/medRxiv preprints by category and log each to the audit trail.

tools.name: get_execution
tools.description: Fetch one execution record, including output artifact hashes.

tools.name: list_executions
tools.description: List recent execution records, newest first.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Fetch an output artifact by its sha256 (text only; capped in size).

tools.name: verify_executions
tools.description: Verify the execution hash chain and that every output artifact is intact.

tools.name: replay_execution
tools.description: Re-run a recorded execution and report whether its outputs reproduced. Writes nothing.

tools.name: get_retrieval
tools.description:
Retrieve a full retrieval record by its retrieval_id.

    Args:
        retrieval_id: the UUID returned by search_pubmed

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
